meta.readmeMarkdown:
# WaveLogGate for TX-5DR

Real-time WaveLog integration plugin for TX-5DR.

## Features

- Frequency synchronization
- Operating mode synchronization
- WaveLog API integration
- Digital mode support

## Repository

https://github.com/BI7ALG/tx5dr-waveloggate-plugin

en.pluginDescription: Synchronize TX-5DR radio frequency and operating mode to WaveLog in real time.
en.apiUrlDescription: WaveLog radio API endpoint. If the path is omitted, /index.php/api/radio is appended automatically.
en.apiKeyDescription: WaveLog API key used to authorize radio status updates.
en.radioNameDescription: Radio identifier sent to WaveLog with each frequency and mode update.
en.pollIntervalDescription: How often TX-5DR checks the current radio state and sends changed values to WaveLog.

zh.pluginDescription: 将 TX-5DR 当前电台频率和工作模式实时同步到 WaveLog。
zh.apiUrlDescription: WaveLog 电台 API 地址。若未包含接口路径，插件会自动追加 /index.php/api/radio。
zh.apiKeyDescription: 用于向 WaveLog 上报电台状态的 API Key。
zh.radioNameDescription: 每次向 WaveLog 上报频率和模式时使用的电台标识。
zh.pollIntervalDescription: TX-5DR 检查当前电台状态并向 WaveLog 发送变化值的频率。
